name: 道の駅 豊前おこしかけ
desc: 福岡県豊前市、国道10号沿いにある道の駅「豊前おこしかけ」。名前の由来は神功皇后が石に腰を掛けたという伝説からきています。特産品は、豊前海で水揚げされた新鮮なカキやハモなどの魚介類や、香り高いゆずを使った加工品。また、地元農家が育てる朝採れ野菜やいちじくなどの旬のフルーツも大人気です。木のぬくもりを感じる大きな屋根の施設で、美味しい特産品と歴史のロマンに触れられる憩いのスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 10 in Buzen City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Buzen Okoshikake" gets its name from a legend that Empress Jingu once sat on a stone here. Its local specialties include fresh seafood like oysters and pike conger from the Buzen Sea, as well as products made with fragrant yuzu. Morning-harvested vegetables and seasonal fruits like figs grown by local farmers are also highly popular. Featuring a large, welcoming wooden roof, it is a relaxing spot where you can enjoy delicious local foods and a touch of historical romance.
